message.content: Ending my turn without building or unmortgaging anything. A hotel would cost $100 and leave me with only $17, while adding just $125 in rent on that property. It would also put 4 houses back in the bank, and with only 6 left, that would let gpt-6.1-sol build up its properties faster. Keeping the cash helps me cover rent when I land on someone else's property.
message.reasoning:
With $117, upgrading to a hotel on St Charles would push rent to $750 but leave me only $17 in cash, which feels too risky given opponents' heavy Park Place and Boardwalk rents I couldn't cover anyway.

Building the hotel also returns houses to the bank, letting p4 expand further — bad for me since scarce houses currently limit their building. I'll keep my cash reserve instead and end the turn.
